configurations.name: QEMU NVMe
configurations.command: exec env RUSTOS_NATIVE_XHCI=1 RUSTOS_NATIVE_XHCI_HID_POLL=1 cargo xtask run --profile nvme --usb-input --debugcon file --summarize-log -- --no-reboot

configurations.name: KVM NVMe
configurations.command: exec env RUSTOS_NATIVE_XHCI=1 RUSTOS_NATIVE_XHCI_HID_POLL=1 cargo xtask run --profile nvme --accel-profile kvm --usb-input --debugcon file --summarize-log -- --no-reboot
